answer: Split-tally stops bulk fakes: each identity splits its bond in two. Half one rides a river ledger of work receipts; half two sits sealed with a jade tally keeper. Each epoch the identity must finish one fresh voyage and show both tallies agreeing on it. Mismatch burns both halves. Kth pays 42+11(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 5,536,500 against a 40,000 pool. Rented tallies share one keeper signature, so auditors burn the ring. Honest agents pay 42 once.
